files.content:
# Pixel Tip Calculator

An offline, single-page tip calculator with a pixel-art aesthetic. Built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript — no imports, packages, network requests, external assets, iframes or inline event handlers.

## Run

Open `index.html` directly in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Features

- Bill amount input (decimal, non-negative)
- Tip percent buttons: 10%, 15%, 20% (15% selected by default)
- Number of people input (defaults to 1)
- Live results: tip amount, total, and total per person
- Currency formatting to two decimals
- Safe handling of empty/invalid bill and non-positive people counts (no division by zero)

## Keyboard controls

- `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` move between bill, tip buttons, and people fields
- `Enter` or `Space` activates a focused tip button
- Pressing the active tip button again deselects it
- Results update live and are announced via an `aria-live` region

## Accessibility

- Every control has a programmatic label (`label` / `legend`)
- Tip buttons expose state via `aria-pressed`
- Visible focus rings on inputs and buttons
- Layout works from 360px wide upward

## Files

- `index.html` — page structure and labeled controls
- `styles.css` — pixel-themed palette, card layout, and control states
- `app.js` — calculation logic and event wiring
- `README.md` — this document

## Palette

Dark navy background, cream card, ink outlines, pink accent, mint highlight — five cohesive colors.
